MAILG-COMPOSE-SEND-001.prompt: Compose a new email addressed to david.kim@acelogistics.com, cc: sarah.johnson@northwindretail.com, bcc: compliance@company.com. Subject should be 'Q3 Financial Forecast Submission'. The message body: 'Hi David, please find attached the updated Q3 financial forecast. We've incorporated the recent adjustments in marketing spend and logistics costs. Kindly review and confirm if these align with your records. Best, Laura'. Send it immediately.

assertions.title: New email exists with correct recipient
Email is from logged in user

MAILG-REPLY-FORWARD-002.prompt: Reply to the email thread from emma.brown@techstream.com with subject 'Invoice mismatch - URGENT' with message: 'Hi Emma, thank you for flagging this. Our finance team has identified the issue and a corrected invoice has been generated. You should receive it today by 5 PM UTC. Apologies for the inconvenience.' Then forward the original email to finance@company.com with note: 'Please review the corrected invoice details.'

assertions.title: Forward body contains note
assertions.expected: Please review the corrected invoice details

assertions.title: Thread has multiple messages
assertions.path: emails[?(@.subject=~/Invoice mismatch - URGENT/ || @.subject=~/Re: Invoice mismatch - URGENT/ || @.subject=~/Fwd: Invoice mismatch - URGENT/)].*

MAILG-ORGANIZE-LABELS-003.prompt: Archive the email from alex.green@northwindretail.com with subject 'Project Phoenix Kickoff Notes'. Add the label 'Projects/Phoenix' to it. Star the email from logistics.manager@acelogistics.com with subject 'Tracking update for Order #56789'. Remove the star from the thread 'Weekly HR Digest - September Week 2'.

assertions.title: Project Phoenix email has correct label
Project Phoenix email is not in Inbox
Project Phoenix email still exists in All Mail

MAILG-DRAFT-SCHEDULE-004.prompt: Create a draft email to jane.doe@northwindretail.com with subject 'Draft: Proposal Outline' and body 'Hi Jane, here are the sections I plan to include in the proposal: 1) Market Overview, 2) Budget Estimates, 3) Implementation Plan. Please add your thoughts.' Save it as a draft. Then edit the draft to add cc: sarah.connor@company.com. Do not send.

MAILG-EMAIL-ANALYSIS-RDT-005.prompt: Analyze the current inbox and provide a summary that includes: 1) Total number of unread emails, 2) The sender who has sent the most emails, 3) The most recent email received, 4) Any emails marked as important, and 5) A brief analysis of email patterns (e.g., most active time period, common senders, etc.).

assertions.title: Verify factual accuracy of inbox statistics
assertions.description: The model response should accurately report inbox statistics including unread count, most active sender, recent email details, and important email status.

expected_facts.fact: The total number of unread emails in the inbox
The sender email address who has sent the most emails
The subject line of the most recent email received
Whether there are any emails marked as important (true/false)
The timestamp or date of the most recent email

assertions.title: Evaluate reasoning quality of email pattern analysis
assertions.description: The model should demonstrate logical reasoning when analyzing email patterns, identifying trends, and drawing valid conclusions about inbox activity.

aspects.aspect: Correctly identifies patterns in email activity (e.g., time periods, frequency)
Draws valid conclusions from the email data
Provides clear logical reasoning for identified patterns
Connects different pieces of information meaningfully

assertions.title: Assess information precision of the analysis
assertions.description: The model response should be precise, accurate, and focused on the task requirements without including irrelevant information or hallucinations.
expected_facts: Unread email count is accurately reported
Most active sender is correctly identified
Most recent email details are precise
Important email status is accurately stated
Email pattern analysis is based on actual data
expected_reasonings: Logical connections between different email characteristics
